title: Adapters translate interfaces
summary: An adapter changes one form of input or output into another. It lets two parts work together without changing both.
introduction: An adapter changes one form of input or output into another. It lets two parts work together without changing both. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question
